name: delete_provider_connection
title: Delete provider connection
description: Delete an inactive, unreferenced provider connection and its connection-scoped credentials after confirm=true and expected_revision checks. Reject active operations or references from any current meeting or profile selection instead of leaving dangling selections; this check covers minutes_model, transcription_model, and every minutes_ensemble generator and synthesizer. Historical provenance references alone do not block deletion, and all past non-secret provenance remains preserved. This never logs out another connection or modifies global SDK state. The same request_id returns the original deletion receipt. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: invalid_argument, not_found, configuration_conflict, busy, authentication_required, internal. All provider operations require the authenticated resident server; no implicit in-process or unauthenticated HTTP fallback is allowed.
